nodes.label: Toba Patch Notes (PATCH-NOTES.md)
nodes.rationale: Changelog of every patch; each patch appended at the end, old content never rewritten (replaced LEIA-ME.md in v1.18).

nodes.label: Toba Routine (Rotina, Task, Agenda, Calendar) - v1.41
Toba Kitchen (Receitas, Semana, Compras, Chas) - v1.43
Toba Tourism / Toba Places - v1.55
nodes.rationale: Shown as 'Toba Tourism' since v1.56 but folders/DB stay TobaTurism so no data is lost.

nodes.label: Toba Drive (GPS com voz) - v1.65
nodes.rationale: Became a module of Toba Racing in v1.66; moved to TobaRacing/TobaDrive/ and renamed from 'Navegar' in v1.83.

nodes.label: App Android (TobaAndroid APK) - v1.34
nodes.rationale: WebView wrapping the published site; site patches don't need a new APK, only native changes do.

nodes.label: Toba dos amigos (social, vitrine) - v1.61
nodes.rationale: Friends only see a summary 'vitrine'; Bank never shown, weight off by default.

nodes.label: Perfil do jogador (XP, nivel, streak, conquistas) - v1.40
nodes.rationale: XP is always recalculated from data, never stored, so it never duplicates and deleting a workout removes its XP.

nodes.label: Hall dos Herois
nodes.rationale: Lifetime Hall moved from Treinos to the Perfil in v1.47; monthly Hall stays in Treinos.

nodes.label: Importar historico do Samsung Health (CSV) - v1.89
nodes.rationale: Samsung doesn't resend history to Health Connect; import only fills empty fields so Health Connect stays authoritative.

nodes.label: Samsung Health Data SDK direto - v1.98 (APK 2.6)
nodes.rationale: Reads skin temp, Energy Score and Samsung sleep score that Samsung never sends to Health Connect; .aar not committed (Samsung license).

nodes.label: Treino ao vivo com regua e timer de descanso - v1.27
nodes.rationale: Timers use wall-clock timestamps so they stay correct when the screen sleeps.

nodes.label: Treino do Saitama ao vivo - v1.36
Caminhada/Corrida ao vivo com GPS - v1.84
nodes.rationale: Uses the Leaflet map from Places, not Mapbox, to save the Drive's Mapbox quota.

nodes.label: Mapa de calor dos musculos - v1.30
nodes.rationale: Measured by reps/effort, not kg, so legs don't always win; v1.45 splits effort between muscles and normalizes by a reference load.

nodes.label: Peso levantado (inclui peso do corpo) - v1.23
Gastos automaticos pelas notificacoes / compras pra aprovar
nodes.rationale: Since v1.47 nothing enters the month automatically: purchases wait for approval and only leave the native queue after saving.

nodes.label: Livre hoje carrega o estouro de ontem - v1.35
Categorias novas do Gastos (ids curtos) - v1.35
nodes.rationale: Old text categories migrated on load and kept in oldCategory; a one-time PRE_CATEGORIES backup is made.

nodes.label: Risquinho do ritmo do orcamento - v2.07
Investimentos repaginados com previa do IR - v1.70
Task (tarefas nao rotineiras com sugestao de dia) - v1.42
Lista de compras (Escolher por chip) - v1.53/v1.54
Combustivel e km/l de tanque cheio a tanque cheio - v1.51
Mapa do Toba Places (Leaflet + CARTO/TomTom) - v1.56
nodes.rationale: v1.58 bounds Nominatim search to the list's city after pins landed in Lisbon's 'Sao Paulo'.

nodes.label: TomTom (rotas e transito ao vivo) - v1.66
nodes.rationale: Free tier; on refusal it is disabled 6h per device and falls back to CARTO/OSM (Valhalla, OSRM).

nodes.label: Mapbox 3D (predios, luz do dia) - v1.69
nodes.rationale: Replaced the classic map; since v1.70 no plan B map, navigation continues without map.

nodes.label: Modo jogo do Toba Drive - v1.68
Ghost race (fantasma da mesma rota) - v1.68
Radares do OpenStreetMap (Overpass)
nodes.rationale: Filtered to own lane/direction (v1.82, v2.03) so bridge/opposite-lane radars stay silent.

nodes.label: Viagens do Android Auto no historico - v2.02
Paradas no caminho / Juntar e Separar viagens - v2.05
Transito pintando a propria rota
nodes.rationale: Iterated v1.71-v2.07: from wide underlay to recoloring the route line itself, then live Mapbox traffic matched to same direction.

nodes.label: Personalizar (avatar, moldura, cor, fundo) - v1.62
nodes.rationale: Items with 'extra' don't enter automatic selection so people who never chose don't change look.

nodes.label: Sono turbinado (hipnograma, nota do Cloba) - v1.98
Prontidao do Cloba
nodes.rationale: Readiness score vs the user's own normal; sleep bank removed in v1.99 at user request.

nodes.label: Passos turbinados - v2.01
nodes.rationale: 'Fecha em' projection uses already-walked + rest of day at 30-day normal pace instead of stretching current pace.

nodes.label: Visao do dia no Raio-X - v1.95
Balanca no Raio-X (basal da balanca) - v1.95
Corpo por dentro / RAIO ULTRA X - v1.94
Tensao do Cloba (stress pelo batimento) - v2.04
nodes.rationale: Samsung doesn't send stress anywhere readable live, so it's estimated from heart rate; v2.11 baseline fixed to early-morning HR to stop inflation.

nodes.label: Nota do Dia do Cloba - v2.04
Treinos do relogio sem duplicar (Mesclar/Virar treino/Ignorar) - v1.89
nodes.rationale: Originally the user's data ruled the merge; since v2.04 the watch numbers rule and prior values are kept in watch.prev.

nodes.label: Uma fonte por dia (passos sem duplicar) - v1.93 (APK 2.4)
nodes.rationale: Health Connect summed Samsung Health's single daily record and the phone's step fragments; keeping the max source per day fixes it.

nodes.label: Raio-X do treino (carga, zonas, VO2) - v2.10 (APK 3.3)
Carga do mes semana a semana - v2.12
Pesagem com periodo, tendencia e Papo reto - v1.64/v1.68
nodes.rationale: Chart equalized per weigh-in (index axis) in v1.68 because spaced weigh-ins made a date axis lopsided; trend still computed over real time.

nodes.label: Local primeiro (localStorage como casa dos dados)
nodes.rationale: Data lives in each browser's localStorage; the cloud only keeps a per-account copy, nothing is lost without a copy, offline keeps working.

nodes.label: Instalar APK do Auto pelo KingInstaller
nodes.rationale: The Android Auto validator hides apps not installed from Play; installing via adb makes Toba disappear from the car. Never uninstall.

nodes.label: Service worker sw.js (PRECACHE/VERSION)
nodes.rationale: v1.26 network-first with no-cache so phones don't mix new HTML with old JS after publishing.

nodes.label: routineAbsorbNativeDone()
nodes.rationale: Moved native 'Feito' queue reading out of the Rotina page so every screen absorbs it (v1.83); unreadable DB never drains the queue.
